# Northwind Terminal

> A command line client for the Northwind order service, documented for people and for automated readers alike.

Paths in this file are relative to the file itself. Remote addresses are recorded
in a capture rather than fetched during an audit.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install the client and run a first order query.
- [API reference](docs/api-reference.md): commands, flags and exit codes the client accepts.
- [Deployment](docs/deployment.md): running the client from a scheduled job.

## Optional

- [Release history](https://example.com/northwind/releases): dated record of published versions.
